acceptance_criteria: Spec identifies cache key/fingerprint responsibilities and product defaults; implementation exposes automatic safe eval caching for deterministic scorer/evaluator paths, restores cache across run_dir resume, reports hit/miss/bypass, and proves zero repeated metric calls.
closed_reason: First eval-cache product integration slice landed. StandardRunSummary exposes RunCacheSummary/EvaluationCacheSummary over engine cache events, durable run-dir summaries report checkpointed-run-store cache backend and disabled-by-policy bypasses, ephemeral runs report non-durable in-memory cache state, and engine deterministic cache resume proof verifies no repeated evaluator call/cost after checkpoint restore. Checks passed: cargo nextest run -p leaven-run --test optimize_builder --test scoring_evaluator; cargo fmt -p leaven-engine -p leaven-run --check; cargo nextest run -p leaven-engine --test context_services. SQLite eval-cache backend remains tracked as leaven-env.10.
